items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: I think it was Chinese. I think it was Chinese.

ctx.x: Yeah. Who was my drum with you then? You didn't have that, do you remember? Gosh.
I think it was Chinese. I think it was Chinese. It's been quite a long while, I guess I remember.
Did you hear him play when he came back, Chinese?
